design_status: Dimensions not listed in measurement_status are proposed design values. V3 Signature retains the 166 x 160 mm chassis footprint and all user-reported component dimensions. It lowers the phone by 19 mm and adds a folded chest collar, faceted neck cuff, two rear tie eyes and a tail-removal arrow to the compact V3 body. Tie slots are proposed 3.2 x 7 mm openings; actual tie/cable fit is pending. Socket/root clearance 0.4 mm per side remains untested. Fasteners, actual stability, printer and physical fit remain unverified.
